name: truncation_detection
description: Penalizes outputs that appear truncated (missing closing tags).

name: step_structure_bonus
description: Rewards structured reasoning with clear step markers.

name: group_consistency_bonus
description: Rewards answers that match the majority answer within the same question group.

name: ngram_repetition_penalty
description: Penalizes repetitive 3-gram patterns in the output text.

name: repetition_density_penalty
description: Penalizes outputs with high 4-gram repetition, indicating degenerate or looping reasoning.

name: verification_mention_bonus
description: Rewards mentioning verification steps in the reasoning process.

name: step_count_efficiency
description: Rewards correct answers with a reasonable number of reasoning steps, penalizing overly step-heavy incorrect solutions.

name: answer_repetition_penalty
description: Penalizes answers that are repeated excessively in the output, indicating potential degeneration or lack of confidence.

name: final_answer_position
description: Rewards correct answers that appear near the end of the output, as expected for a final answer, penalizing early placements.

name: latex_validity_check
description: Checks if LaTeX expressions in the answer are well-formed.

name: group_relative_length_efficiency
description: Rewards correct answers that are shorter than the average length of other correct answers in the same question group, penalizing verbose correct solutions.

name: rambling_sentence_length
description: Penalizes outputs with many overly long sentences, which may indicate rambling or poor structure.

name: thinking_length_balance
description: Rewards a balanced ratio of thinking to solution length, penalizing outputs that are all thinking or all solution.

name: rambling_detector
description: Penalizes overly long sentences in the thinking section which may indicate rambling.

name: thinking_length_penalty
description: Penalizes excessively long thinking blocks to encourage concise reasoning.

name: group_variance_penalty
description: Penalizes incorrect answers more heavily when other samples in the group are correct.

name: group_relative_efficiency
description: Rewards correct answers that are shorter relative to other correct answers in the same group.
